paras: Caledoniscincus chazeaui, also known as Chazeau's litter skink, is a species of lizard in the family Scincidae. The species is endemic to New Caledonia.
The specific name, chazeaui, is in honor of New Caledonian zoologist Jean Chazeau.
The preferred natural habitat of C. chazeaui is forest at altitudes up to 900 m (3,000 ft).
Caledoniscincus chazeaui is terrestrial and diurnal.
The mode of reproduction of C. chazeaui is unknown.
